start: Owner signed in, gym online, gym server has the workout of the day. Menu 'Workout plans', card 'Workout of the day', nothing set

steps.action: Look at the card
user_sees: 'Workout of the day'
'One workout for everyone at your gym. Members see it on the Workout tab of their MettleUp app and start it with one tap.'
'Nothing set for today.'
Button 'Set today’s workout'
must_not: The card drawn for a gym that is not online
Yesterday's workout shown as today's

steps.action: Tap 'Set today’s workout'
user_sees: Sheet 'Workout of the day' with Day (today), 'Start from one of your plans (optional)', 'Workout name', 'Kind of day', 'Note for members (optional)'
'No exercises yet. Pick a plan above, or search below to add one.'
must_not: A day in the past offered
More than today plus 7 days offered

steps.action: Pick a day of a plan under 'Start from one of your plans (optional)'
user_sees: Workout name and the exercises of that day filled in, each with sets, reps, start kg and rest
must_not: The gym's plan itself changed by edits made here

steps.action: Tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: 'Saving…'
Toast 'Saved. Members see it now.'
A row 'Today' with the workout's line and buttons 'Change' and 'Take it off'
The top button now reads '+ Plan another day'
must_not: Two workouts for one day
The toast when the save failed
Members of another gym seeing it

start: Owner signed in, today's workout already set

steps.action: Tap '+ Plan another day'
user_sees: Sheet 'Workout of the day' with Day set to the next free day
must_not: Day preset to a day that already has a workout while a free day exists

steps.action: Type a Workout name, search 'squat' under 'Add an exercise' and tap a result; add one more as '+ Add “…” as your own exercise'
user_sees: Each exercise in its own box with 'Sets', 'Reps from', 'Reps to', 'Rest (seconds)'
For the own exercise: 'Your own exercise' and 'Main muscle'
must_not: More than 30 exercises accepted

steps.action: Tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: Toast 'Saved for tomorrow.' or 'Saved for <date>.'
A new row under today's with that day's name
must_not: Today's workout replaced
The workout shown to members before its day (unknown how the app treats later days)

start: Owner signed in, in the 'Workout of the day' sheet

steps.action: Tap 'Save workout' with no name
user_sees: 'Give the workout a name, for example “Leg day”.'
must_not: A nameless workout saved

steps.action: Type a name, add no exercise, tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: A red line asking for at least one exercise (exact words: unknown)
must_not: An empty workout sent to members

steps.action: Type sets as 0 on an exercise, tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: '<exercise>: sets must be a whole number from 1 to 20.'
must_not: A workout with zero sets saved

steps.action: Choose a Day that already has a workout
user_sees: 'This replaces “<name>”, already set for that day.'
must_not: The other workout replaced without this line

steps.action: Open 'Workout plans' with the gym not online, or on an older gym server
user_sees: No 'Workout of the day' card at all
must_not: A card whose save can never work
An error banner about a missing part

start: Owner signed in, a workout set for today

steps.action: Tap 'Change' on today's row
user_sees: The sheet filled with the saved name, note and exercises
must_not: An empty sheet

steps.action: Change the note, tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: Toast 'Saved. Members see it now.'
One row for today, with the new content
must_not: A second row for the same day
Members who already started it losing their workout

steps.action: Tap 'Take it off'
user_sees: Sheet 'Take this workout off?' with '<name> will no longer show to members for today. Members who already started it keep their workout.'
Buttons 'Keep it' and 'Take it off'
must_not: The workout removed before the question is answered

steps.action: Tap 'Keep it', then 'Take it off' again and confirm with 'Take it off'
user_sees: After 'Keep it': the row is still there
After confirming: toast 'Workout taken off.' and 'Nothing set for today.'
Top button back to 'Set today’s workout'
must_not: The row left on screen after it was taken off
A workout of another day removed

steps.action: Set a workout for today again
user_sees: Toast 'Saved. Members see it now.'
must_not: A refusal because one existed before

start: Owner signed in, writing the note for members

steps.action: Type a note and save the workout
user_sees: The note and workout go to every member of this gym on their Workout tab
must_not: A member's name or health detail typed into the note reaching all members without the writer knowing who reads it
Members of another gym or branch seeing it
The name of who set it shown to members without the gym knowing (the server keeps the setter's name: unknown where it shows)
